text:
Priya: Heads-up - p99 popped for /v2/generate (eu-west) at ~21:30 but p50/p95 steady. sample_count for that slice down ~3x.
Samir: looks like a fallback to compat-lowmem, which has telemetry.downsample=true.
Janelle: Is the dashboard using tdigest rollups or raw samples? Important for tail correctness.
Priya: Console uses tdigest rollups. Query: SELECT tdigest_percentile(rollup_tdigest,0.99), sum(sample_count) FROM endpoint_latency_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v2/generate' AND region='eu-west' GROUP BY time_bucket;
Alex: Downsampling + tdigest = noisy tails. Two quick mitigations: (A) show sample provenance + a low-confidence pill when samples < N, (B) offer an on-demand raw p99 compute.
Samir: +1 for provenance first. We also need to standardize telemetry tag names (routing_policy vs route_variant) otherwise UI grouping will mislabel sources.
Janelle: I'll design a small "provenance" badge next to percentiles with tooltip (sample_source, sample_count) and a "compute raw" button.
Priya: I'll run a 10% canary flipping telemetry.downsample=false for compat-lowmem to confirm.
ops-bot: rollout started by Priya: config.telemetry.downsample=false for route compat-lowmem (canary=10%).
Samir: If canary restores p99, we mark this as sampling artifact and add docs explaining tdigest limits.
Janelle: Will post the mock and link to the dashboard repo once the charts are in.
Priya: Posting before/after in ~20m with tenant ids used in the canary.
